The research phase confirms no explicit or implicit indicators of self-referential consistency in response structure, reinforcing that memory management cannot be superior to static skill sets and Markdown files without observable, cited evidence. This validates the need to halt speculative claims and proceed with bounded, evidence-based conclusions.
